Why Partner with CogniCo?

Small businesses often find AI solutions overwhelming or out of reach—but it doesn’t have to be that way. At CogniCo, we believe innovation shouldn’t be limited by complexity. For businesses like yours,
Time matters. Efficiency matters. Scalability matters. ‍

That’s why we’re here to make AI accessible, practical, and impactful. Our mission is clear: to help you ‍scale faster, operate smarter, and achieve more.‍

6-Phase Approach

Phase 1
Discovery & Evaluation

We start by diving into your unique needs—understanding your processes, analyzing data, and listening to your story. Together, we identify challenges and opportunities, delivering a customized action plan that shows exactly where AI and automation can boost efficiency, cut costs, and drive growth.

Pricing: Start with a free consultation, then opt for a paid strategy workshop ($2500 flat fee).

Phase 2
Strategic Planning & ROI Modelling

Next, we craft a tailored AI strategy that combines data-driven analysis with human judgment. This includes a detailed solution plan and a measurable ROI model, so you know exactly what to expect—both in terms of outcomes and financial impact.

‍Pricing: Included as part of the flat fee of 2500$.

Phase 3
System Development & Integration

We develop high-quality AI solutions designed specifically for your business and seamlessly integrate them into your existing workflows. Rigorous testing and dedicated human oversight ensure the system performs optimally from day one.

Pricing: Starting at $10,000, depending on scope. Monthly subscription and financing available.

Training & Change Management

Adoption is key to success. We empower your team with in-depth training, comprehensive SOPs, and hands-on support to ensure a smooth transition and confident use of the new systems.

Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Our work doesn’t stop at implementation. Through continuous feedback collection and performance tracking, we fine-tune your systems—always keeping a human in the loop—to ensure they evolve with your business and deliver sustained, tangible results.

Who We Are

At CogniCo, we empower small and medium-sized businesses, nonprofits, and charities with intelligent automation and AI integrations, guided by human expertise. Our mission is to simplify workflows, boost productivity, and drive sustainable growth through innovative, purpose-driven solutions. CogniCo was founded by Mehnaz Tabassum and Saif Ahmed—two leaders united by a passion for innovation and a desire to create meaningful change.

Learn More

Mehnaz a dynamic entrepreneur and agile project management expert, has led high-stakes digital transformations and hosts, a podcast that demystifies AI for businesses. Saif, a visionary in data science and AI, brings years of experience from groundbreaking projects with the Government of Canada. Together, they co-founded NL Eats Community Outreach Inc., a registered charity where they automated processes using AI, growing operations by 78% over four years. These experiences taught them the challenges faced by SMBs, nonprofits, and charities—inspiring them to create CogniCo. Leveraging their combined network of 30,000+ LinkedIn professionals, they built a team of developers, AI experts, and subject matter experts to deliver practical, impactful and cost effective solutions.For Saif and Mehnaz, CogniCo is more than a consulting firm—it’s a mission to empower organizations with technology that drives innovation, efficiency, and growth.

Data Processing Agreement

close

This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") forms part of the Terms of Service between CogniCo AI Consulting ("CogniCo," "we," "us," or "our") and the organization agreeing to these terms ("Customer," "you," or "your"). This DPA reflects the parties' agreement with respect to the processing of Personal Data by CogniCo on behalf of the Customer in connection with the services provided by CogniCo.

1. Definitions

"Personal Data"
means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person ('data subject'); an identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly.
‍
"Processing"
means any operation or set of operations which is performed on Personal Data, whether or not by automated means, such as collection, recording, organization, structuring, storage, adaptation or alteration, retrieval, consultation, use, disclosure by transmission, dissemination or otherwise making available, alignment or combination, restriction, erasure or destruction.
‍
"Data Controller"
means the entity which determines the purposes and means of the Processing of Personal Data.
‍
"Data Processor"
means the entity which Processes Personal Data on behalf of the Data Controller.
‍
"Services"
means the AI consulting, implementation, and capacity building services provided by CogniCo to Customer.

2. Roles and Responsibilities
2.1 Customer as Data Controller

Customer acts as the Data Controller with respect to the Personal Data processed by CogniCo on Customer's behalf in the provision of the Services.

2.2 CogniCo as Data Processor

CogniCo acts as the Data Processor with respect to the Personal Data processed on behalf of Customer in the provision of the Services.

3. Processing of Personal Data
3.1 Purpose of Processing

CogniCo shall Process Personal Data only for the purpose of providing the Services to Customer and in accordance with Customer's documented instructions.

3.2 Categories of Data

The types of Personal Data processed may include, but are not limited to:

  • Contact information (name, email, phone number)
  • Professional information (job title, department)
  • User account information
  • Usage data related to the Services
  • Any other Personal Data submitted by or for Customer through the Services
3.3 Duration of Processing

CogniCo will Process Personal Data for the duration of the Services agreement, unless otherwise agreed upon in writing.

4. Data Security
4.1 Security Measures

CogniCo shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including:

  • Encryption of Personal Data where appropriate
  • Ability to ensure ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability, and resilience of processing systems and services
  • Ability to restore availability and access to Personal Data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident
  • Process for regularly testing, assessing, and evaluating the effectiveness of security measures
4.2 Staff Confidentiality

CogniCo shall ensure that all personnel who have access to Personal Data are subject to confidentiality obligations.

5. Subprocessors
5.1 Authorization

Customer provides general authorization for CogniCo to engage subprocessors to Process Personal Data in connection with the provision of Services.

5.2 Notification

CogniCo shall inform Customer of any intended changes concerning the addition or replacement of subprocessors, providing Customer with the opportunity to object to such changes.

5.3 Subprocessor Obligations

CogniCo shall ensure that subprocessors are bound by written agreements that require them to provide at least the level of data protection required of CogniCo under this DPA.

6. Data Subject Rights

CogniCo shall, to the extent legally permitted, promptly notify Customer if it receives a request from a Data Subject to exercise their rights under applicable data protection laws. Taking into account the nature of the Processing, CogniCo shall assist Customer by implementing appropriate technical and organizational measures to help Customer fulfill its obligation to respond to Data Subject requests.

7. Data Breach Notification

CogniCo shall notify Customer without undue delay after becoming aware of a Personal Data breach affecting Customer's Personal Data. Such notification shall include the nature of the breach, the categories and approximate number of Data Subjects concerned, the likely consequences of the breach, and measures taken or proposed to address the breach.

8. Data Protection Impact Assessment

Upon Customer's request, CogniCo shall provide Customer with reasonable assistance in carrying out data protection impact assessments and prior consultations with supervisory authorities, taking into account the nature of Processing and the information available to CogniCo.

9. Return or Deletion of Data

Upon termination of the Services, CogniCo shall, at Customer's choice, delete or return all Personal Data to Customer and delete existing copies unless applicable law requires storage of the Personal Data.

10. Audit Rights

CogniCo shall make available to Customer all information necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations set forth in this DPA and shall allow for and contribute to audits, including inspections, conducted by Customer or another auditor mandated by Customer.

11. International Data Transfers

CogniCo shall not transfer Personal Data outside of Canada without the prior written consent of Customer and ensuring that appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

12. Modifications

This DPA may only be modified by a written amendment signed by both parties.

Contact Information

For questions about this Data Processing Agreement, please contact us at privacy@cognico.ca

Information Sharing

2. Legal Compliance

We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, property, or the safety of our users and the public.

3. Business Transfers

In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your personal information may be transferred as part of the transaction. We will notify you via email and/or a prominent notice on our website of any change in ownership or uses of your personal information.

Data Security
1. Security Measures

CogniCo implements advanced security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include:

  • Encryption of sensitive data
  • Secure network architecture
  • Regular security assessments
  • Access controls and authentication
2. Data Retention

We retain personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy or as required by law. When data is no longer needed, it is securely deleted or anonymized.

Your Choices
1. Access and Control

You have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Correct inaccuracies in your personal information
  • Request deletion of your personal information
  • Object to or restrict certain processing of your data
  • Request a copy of your data in a portable format

To exercise these rights, please contact us at privacy@cognico.ca

2. Opt-Out

You can opt out of receiving promotional communications from us at any time by:

  • Following the unsubscribe instructions in our emails
  • Contacting us directly at privacy@cognico.ca
3. Cookies

Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through browser settings. You can choose to block or delete cookies, but this may affect your experience on our website.

Compliance and Privacy Standards

At CogniCo, we adhere to all major privacy standards, including:

  • PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act)
  • GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)
  • CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

Our compliance ensures your personal data is handled responsibly and securely.

Children's Privacy

Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at privacy@cognico.ca

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.

Report a Vulnerability

close

At CogniCo, we value your data security and privacy. We appreciate your assistance in identifying and reporting any vulnerabilities you may discover in our systems or services.

How to Report a Vulnerability

Email Your Findings
Send your vulnerability report to security@cognico.ca

Provide Detailed Information
Include a detailed description of the vulnerability, including steps to reproduce the issue.

Include Supporting Materials
Attach any relevant files, code snippets, or screenshots that help illustrate the vulnerability.

Reporting Guidelines

Provide sufficient information for our team to understand and reproduce the issue.

Do not exploit the vulnerability or share it publicly before it is resolved.

Ensure all communications are conducted within the bounds of legal and ethical standards.

Our Response Process

We will acknowledge receipt of your report promptly.

Our security team will investigate and validate the reported vulnerability

Once validated, we will work to address and resolve the issue in a timely manner.

We may offer recognition for significant contributions to our platform's security.

Important Note

CogniCo reserves the right to address vulnerabilities at its discretion. We are committed to maintaining open communication with security researchers and appreciate their assistance in ensuring a secure environment for all users.
